source: Balluff user's guide BNI PNT-50X-105-Z015 (order code BNI004U): '502 = IP 67 IO-Link master module, 4 IO-Link ports'; 'ports 0-3 IN / OUT; ports 4-7 IN / OUT / IO-Link' (4 further sockets are plain I/O); 'IP 67 (only in plugged-in and screwed-down state)'; 'Dimensions (W x H x D in mm) 68 x 224 x 37.9'. The guide never states 'class A'; port_class A is read from the pinout '5 n.a.' (no aux supply on pin 2/5 of the IO-Link sockets, pin 2 is I/O). Vendor ID and IO-Link spec version not stated.
